{{Youmay|the animal|[[Worm (individual)|Worm]], a person in disguise}}
[[File:Wormpic.jpg|thumb|Worms scavenging the carcass of a [[Falumpaset/Legends|Falumpaset]]]]
{{Quote|You worms are no match for the dark side!|Darth Maul|<ref name="battlefront2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Worms''' were soft-bodied invertebrates found on numerous worlds, including [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Some species were scavengers. [[Rotworm]]s were a type of worm.

Giant worms lived in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Undercity (Taris)|undercity]], and once were the object of a particularly dangerous [[Racing wings|racing wing]] stunt by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The object was to retrieve a scale from one of the worms, who lived in a spot that was particularly difficult to access by racing wing. Skywalker, then merely a young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], failed to negotiate the distance correctly, and had to be rescued from the worms by his [[Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

==As insult==
"Worm" was also used as a derogatory remark or modifier. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] sometimes used this term to taunt his opponents when he believed they were lesser beings than himself, therefore deserving to be associated with worms. The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] was also known to have called her opponents worms on occasion. Just prior to the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] insulted [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by calling him a "slimy piece of worm-ridden filth".

Lt. [[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]] of [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]] was known to call her forces "incompetent worms" for failure such as when her forces failed to capture parts for an [[Orbital Defense Cannon]]. It was also a common expression to be "as dirty and happy as a worm".
